pages.title: Blue Wildebeest
pages.text: The blue wildebeest ($(o)Connochaetes taurinus$()) is a grazing antelope of the savannas of eastern and southern Africa.$(br2)It is slate grey with dark stripes on its neck and shoulders, a black mane and beard, and cow-like horns.$(br2)Over a million of them make the Great Migration every year, following the rains across the Serengeti.
